# Kenney Space Kit 1.0 (selected source models)

- Author: Kenney
- Official source: https://kenney.nl/assets/space-kit
- Official archive: https://kenney.nl/media/pages/assets/space-kit/20874c75ac-1677698978/kenney_space-kit.zip
- Version: 1.0 (2020)
- License: Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal
- Archive SHA-256: `D5D7CDF2635ED5A43A9187DEAF409B6F47484E402321128341D3C3698E9EF4D9`

Only the FBX models needed for the Kromka strategic-map science facilities
are retained. The original `License.txt` is stored beside this file. Models
remain unmodified source assets; scale, materials and placement are authored
non-destructively in Unity editor scripts.
